name: hybrid-music-5000
description: The Hybrid Music 5000 synthesiser, or its Music 3000 expander, which adds sixteen channels of digital sound on the 1 MHz bus.

parameters.label: Unit
parameters.description: Which board this is: the synthesiser itself, or the expander that adds a second set of channels.

choices.label: Music 5000 synthesiser
choices.description: Answers to JIM pages &30-&3F; its sound is audio field 2.

choices.label: Music 3000 expander
choices.description: Answers to JIM pages &50-&5F; its sound is audio field 3.
